scope: Theorem 5.1 (Information from shared exact data) of the manuscript “Posterior replicas and conditional information in Gaussian regression” (preprints/Posterior-replicas-and-conditional-information-in-Gaussian-regression-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 140 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 135be898557ce66e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let P = fσd be a probability with a nonnegative Borel density f ≤ eb, where b ≥ 0. Let S ∼ P, let A be an independent k × d standard Gaussian matrix, and put Y = AS. Let a finite message W be drawn from a kernel of (A, Y ), conditionally independently of S. Let B be a p × d standard Gaussian matrix independent of the entire joint experiment producing (S, A, Y, W). Then I(S; W | B, BS) ≤ H(W) q + C  d + b d  (42) for an absolute C, uniformly over the prior and message kernel.
